item.description: Automated Financial Systems, a long-established provider of commercial loan servicing and loan lifecycle management technology for financial institutions, has been acquired by private equity firm OceanSound Partners in a deal aimed at accelerating product innovation and expanding capabilities for banks and other lenders.
